title: The Blessing and Curse of Dimensionality in Safety Alignment

summary.claim: High hidden dimensions help LLM performance but create linear structure in activation space that activation engineering can exploit to bypass safety alignment. Projecting representations to a lower dimension makes these jailbreaks less effective.
summary.condition: LLMs of several sizes, jailbreaks via representation engineering; theory linking hidden dimension and linear jailbreaks.
summary.gap: (Inferred) The abstract does not say whether reducing dimension also blocks general performance or useful steering.
